description: This file defines the 'Information' controller class for an OpenCart extension module. It handles generating a view that lists informational pages and links such as contact and sitemap, by loading relevant models and language files, assembling URL data, and rendering a view template.

classes.name: ControllerExtensionOpencartModuleInformation
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying a list of information pages within the OpenCart store, assembling data, and rendering the associated view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked to generate the information list view, loads models and language files, gathers information data, creates URLs, and returns the rendered view HTML.
